hints.en: Under the job, in the same column as `runs-on`: `needs:`.
For two jobs, a list: `needs: [lint, test]`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

**.github/workflows/ci.yml**

```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: pip install ruff
      - run: ruff check .
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: python -m pytest
  build:
    needs: [lint, test]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: python -m pip wheel . -w dist
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

**.github/workflows/ci.yml**

```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: pip install ruff
      - run: ruff check .
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: python -m pytest
  build:
    needs: [lint, test]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: python -m pip wheel . -w dist
```
